title: The shifted geometric mean
heading: The Shifted Geometric Mean Summarizes Ratios, and Its Shift Keeps Easy Instances From Dominating
cases: with a shift of 0 and values of at least 1, the result is the plain geometric mean
the shift is added to every value and subtracted from the result, so identical values give themselves back
a value plus shift below 1 counts as 1 inside the logarithm
the shift given is the one used, and a larger shift brings two solvers that differ only on fast instances closer together
